messages:
Alex (AE): Heads-up — Novara CFO just flagged three showstopper asks for the POC exec signoff: 1) BYO KMS + attestation, 2) Okta SSO + SCIM, 3) committed latency SLA for peak queries. They want an exec bridge tomorrow if we can confirm answers. Can we triage?
Priya (SE): Ack. Quick Q — are they asking for full BYO KMS (HSM integration) or just customer-managed keys in cloud KMS?
Alex (AE): They said HSM-backed, customer controls keys (BYOK). Also asked whether Redwood can do key import vs. external HSM peering.
Jordan (Presales): I ran a short gap analysis this AM. TL;DR: we can support customer-managed keys via KMS integrations (GCP/AWS/Azure) but external HSM peering is non-standard and needs SOC2/legal review. For POC we can offer a KMS proxy flow + transient keys.
Sam (Eng): Technical: for BYO KMS import we need an onboarding ticket + support window. Throughput note: their peak is ~800 qps with 64-token avg -> we recommend a Dedicated pool (2xA100 equiv) or hosted w/ reserved capacity. Baseline latency numbers (internal perf run):
```json
{"model":"rw-v2-large","seq":64,"p50_ms":48,"p95_ms":120,"p99_ms":210}
```
Those are on our verified profile, but p95 will jump under 800 qps without proper batching tuning.
Priya (SE): For Okta/SCIM: we support OIDC + SCIM provisioning. We need their Okta tenant admin to add a Redwood OIDC app and a SCIM integration. Can we draft a short runbook for them?
Lina (Security): From security side: BYO KMS + HSM peering triggers additional controls. We need KMS attestation doc, key rotation policy, and a run of the security questionnaire. Also ask: do they require egress encryption to a specific gateway/allowlist?
Alex (AE): They mentioned peering to an on-prem gateway for egress filtering. Also want an SLA clause: 99.9% availability and p95 latency <= 200ms for the POC window.
Sam (Eng): p95 <= 200ms at 800 qps is feasible with Dedicated + autoscale + batching, but needs an SRE-approved runbook and canary. We should propose a fallback model (smaller model) if load spikes. Suggest: primary = rw-v2-large quantized, fallback = rw-v2-medium.
Maria (Legal): On SLAs: standard trial POCs don't include contractual uptime SLAs. If customer insists, we can offer a timeboxed SLA for the pilot with a limited credit schedule, but need sales legal review. Also BYO KMS requires a KMS addendum (we have a template) and likely additional indemnities.
Jordan (Presales): Proposed POC timeline to present to customer: Day 0-3: onboarding + KMS paperwork; Day 4-6: Okta + SCIM setup; Day 7-10: load runs + latency tuning; Day 11: exec bridge + signoff. Can accelerate if they provide dev access earlier.
Alex (AE): They want price delta for Dedicated/reserved for the pilot vs hosted pay-as-you-go. Who can pull a cost delta + recommended commitment?
Priya (SE): I can run rough estimates. If we assume 2xA100 equiv reserved for 1 week, internal list says ~ $X/day (I'll do exact numbers). Also include potential add-on for KMS attestation support.
Sam (Eng): Action: I will spin a perf cluster in staging and run a quick 800 qps test tomorrow morning. Need flag: `--kv-cache-enabled` and `--continuous-batching=aggressive`.
Jordan (Presales): I will draft a 1-page runbook for Okta + SCIM + KMS BYO steps and a short customer checklist.
Lina (Security): I'll pull the BYO KMS attestation template and mark which answers need customer input. Also will open a questionnaire thread with Novara SOC contact.
Maria (Legal): I'll queue the KMS addendum with Sales Legal. Alex, please send me the customer's redlines if any.
ops-bot: ticket #ST-11234 created: "Novara POC — BYO KMS + Okta + SLA review" assigned to eng-oncall. https://redwood.atlassian.net/browse/ST-11234
Alex (AE): Can we commit to an exec bridge tomorrow 10:30am PT? CFO said that's their window. If not, propose alternatives.
Sam (Eng): 10:30am PT works for eng. I'll be on the bridge with perf results.
Priya (SE): I'm good at 10:30, will bring the runbook.
Jordan (Presales): I'll draft the bridge agenda: 1) quick recap (3m), 2) security/KMS path (7m), 3) Okta/SCIM steps (7m), 4) cost/Reserved options (5m), 5) next steps and signoff (3m).
Lina (Security): I'll join for KMS attestation portion.
Maria (Legal): I'll be on standby but might not join unless there are redlines.
Alex (AE): Great. Owners: Sam -> perf tests & cluster; Priya -> cost delta + runbook; Jordan -> bridge agenda + timeline; Lina -> attestation doc & questionnaire; Maria -> KMS addendum. I'll own exec scheduling and customer comms.
Priya (SE): Quick note for the bridge: include `--kv-cache-enabled` as a recommended toggle in the tuning slide. :thumbsup:
Sam (Eng): Will post perf logs here after the morning run. snippet of the command I'll run:
```bash
./run_load_test --model rw-v2-large --concurrency 800 --seq 64 --enable-kv-cache
```
Alex (AE): Thanks team. If we can have the perf numbers and cost delta before 9am PT tomorrow we can prep slides. Otherwise escalate to me.
ops-bot: Reminder scheduled: exec-bridge (Novara) at 2025-05-14T17:30:00Z
Jordan (Presales): Noted — I'll prepare a 3-slide deck and share before 9am PT.
Alex (AE): Closing note: customer priority is speed to go-live but they will not compromise on key control. Let's keep the KMS path explicit.
Priya (SE): On it, filing the cost calc now.
